grammar.title: Third Conditional (虚拟语气过去完成时)
grammar.structure: If + 主语 + had + 过去分词..., 主语 + would/could/might + have + 过去分词
grammar.definition: 表示与过去事实相反的假设，结构为If + 主语 + had + 过去分词, 主语 + would/could/might + have + 过去分词 用于谈论与过去事实相反的假设情况，表达一种假想的、与事实不符的情景

examples.en: If, at the time, the British had not feared invasion, it would have been completed.
examples.zh: 如果当时英国人不害怕入侵，隧道早就建成了。

examples.en: If he had studied harder, he would have passed the exam.
examples.zh: 如果他当时学习更努力，他就能通过考试了。

grammar.title: Passive Voice - Past Simple Passive (一般过去时的被动语态)
grammar.structure: 主语 + was/were + 过去分词
grammar.definition: 当句子的主语是动作的承受者时，使用被动语态。结构为：主语 + be动词 + 过去分词 用于强调动作的承受者，或当动作执行者不明确/不重要时

examples.en: A tunnel was actually begun forty-two years later.
It was officially opened on March 7, 1994.

patterns.pattern: If + 过去完成时, 主语 + would have + 过去分词

original.en: If, at the time, the British had not feared invasion, it would have been completed.
original.zh: 如果当时英国人不害怕入侵，隧道早就建成了。

imitations.en: If I had known about the traffic, I would have left earlier.
imitations.zh: 如果我知道交通状况，我就会早点出发了。

imitations.en: If she had practiced more, she would have won the competition.
imitations.zh: 如果她多练习，她就能赢得比赛了。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + would be possible to + 动词原形

original.en: He said that it would be possible to build a platform in the centre of the Channel.
original.zh: 他说在英吉利海峡中部建造一个平台是可能的。

imitations.zh: 下个月完成这个项目是可能的。

imitations.en: It would be possible to travel to Mars in the future.
imitations.zh: 将来有可能去火星旅行。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词 + 时间/地点

original.en: It was officially opened on March 7, 1994.

lines.en: In 1858, a French engineer, Aime Thome de Gamond, arrived in England with a plan for a twenty-one-mile tunnel under the English Channel.
lines.zh: 1858年，一位名叫埃梅。托梅。德。干蒙的法国工程师带着建造一条长21英里、穿越英吉利海陕的隧道计划到了英国。

lines.en: He said that it would be possible to build a platform in the centre of the Channel.
lines.zh: 他说，可以在隧道中央建造一座平台，这座平台将用作码头和火车站。

lines.en: This platform would serve as a port and a railway station.
lines.zh: 如果再建些伸出海面的高大的烟囱状通风管，隧道就具备了良好的通风条件。

lines.en: The tunnel would be well- ventilated if tall chimneys were built above sea level.
In 1860, a better plan was put forward by an Englishman , William Low.
lines.zh: 洛的英国人提出了一项更好的计划。

lines.en: He suggested that a double railway-tunnel should be built.
lines.zh: 他提议建一条双轨隧道，这样就解决了通风问题。

lines.en: This would solve the problem of ventilation, for if a train entered this tunnel, it would draw in fresh air behind it.
lines.zh: 因为如果有列火车开进隧道，它就把新鲜空气随之抽进了隧道。

lines.en: Forty-two years later a tunnel was actually begun.
lines.zh: 42年以后，隧道实际已经开始建了。

lines.en: If, at the time, the British had not feared invasion , it would have been completed.
lines.zh: 如果不是因为那时英国人害怕入侵，隧道早已建成了。

lines.en: The world had to wait almost another 100 years for the Channel Tunnel.
lines.zh: 世界不得不再等将近100年才看到海峡隧道竣工。

lines.en: It was officially opened on March 7,1994, finally connecting Britain to the European continent.
lines.zh: 它于1994年3月7日正式开通，将英国与欧洲大陆连到了一起。

questions.q: Why was the first tunnel not completed?
questions.zh: 为什么第一条隧道没有建成？
questions.a: Because, at the time, the British feared invasion, so the work was stopped.
questions.aZh: 因为当时英国人害怕入侵，工程因此中止。

questions.q: What did Aimé Thomé de Gamond plan to build in 1858, and what would the platform be used for?
questions.zh: 1858年德·干蒙计划建造什么？平台用来做什么？
questions.a: He arrived in England with a plan for a twenty-one-mile tunnel under the English Channel, and the platform in the centre would serve as a port and a railway station.
questions.aZh: 他带着一条长21英里、穿越英吉利海峡的隧道计划来到英国；建在海峡中央的平台将用作港口和火车站。

questions.q: How would the first tunnel be ventilated, and how did William Low's plan solve the problem of ventilation?
questions.zh: 最初的隧道打算如何通风？威廉·洛的方案怎样解决？
questions.a: Tall chimneys built above sea level would keep the tunnel well-ventilated. Low suggested a double railway-tunnel: if a train entered this tunnel, it would draw in fresh air behind it.
questions.aZh: 修建高大的烟囱状通风管；洛建议双轨隧道，列车开进隧道时会把新鲜空气随之抽进来。

questions.q: When was the Channel Tunnel officially opened, and what did it finally do?
questions.zh: 海峡隧道何时正式开通？它最终起到了什么作用？
questions.a: It was officially opened on March 7, 1994, finally connecting Britain to the European continent.
questions.aZh: 它于1994年3月7日正式开通，终于把英国与欧洲大陆连接了起来。

questions.q: Compare 'If, at the time, the British had not feared invasion, it would have been completed.' with 'If a train entered this tunnel, it would draw in fresh air behind it.'
questions.zh: 比较这两个条件句，它们各属第几类？
questions.a: The first is a Type 3 conditional: past perfect in the if-clause and would have + past participle in the main clause; it imagines something that did not happen in the past. The second is a Type 2 conditional: past tense and would + base form; it describes an imagined situation in the present or future.
questions.aZh: 第一句是第3类条件句，表示与过去事实相反的假设；第二句是第2类条件句，表示现在或将来想象中的情况。
questions.hint: 对比课文第 9 句与第 7 句。

translation:
1858年，一位名叫埃梅。
托梅。
德。
干蒙的法国工程师带着建造一条长21英里、穿越英吉利海陕的隧道计划到了英国。
他说，可以在隧道中央建造一座平台，这座平台将用作码头和火车站。
如果再建些伸出海面的高大的烟囱状通风管，隧道就具备了良好的通风条件。
1860年，一位名叫威廉。
洛的英国人提出了一项更好的计划。
他提议建一条双轨隧道，这样就解决了通风问题。
因为如果有列火车开进隧道，它就把新鲜空气随之抽进了隧道。
42年以后，隧道实际已经开始建了。
如果不是因为那时英国人害怕入侵，隧道早已建成了。
世界不得不再等将近100年才看到海峡隧道竣工。
它于1994年3月7日正式开通，将英国与欧洲大陆连到了一起。
title: The Channel Tunnel
subtitle: 海峡隧道

lead.question: 一条穿越英吉利海峡的海底隧道，为什么让世界等了将近一百年？
lead.warmup: 你坐过穿越英吉利海峡的列车吗？从伦敦到巴黎不过两个多小时。可这条海底隧道从设想到通车，走了将近一百四十年：1858年，一位法国工程师带着21英里隧道的计划来到英国；1860年，英国人威廉·洛又提出更完善的双轨方案；42年后工程真正开挖，却因恐惧战争而停工。修建海底隧道最难的问题之一是什么？先想想通风。
goals: 掌握 tunnel、port、ventilate、chimney、sea level、ventilation 等核心词汇
熟练运用 put forward、serve as、draw in、solve the problem of、connect...to 等短语
理解并运用第3类条件句（if + had done, would have done），并能与第2类条件句区分
能按时间线复述海峡隧道从1858年设想到1994年通车的历程
lead.summary: 课文按时间顺序讲述海峡隧道：1858年法国工程师德·干蒙提出21英里隧道方案，拟在海峡中央建平台兼作港口与火车站，靠高出海平面的烟囱通风；1860年威廉·洛提出双轨隧道，用列车带进新鲜空气解决通风；42年后动工，却因英国人惧怕入侵而中止；直到1994年3月7日才正式通车。
lead.tips: 第3类条件句只写“过去没有发生的事”：if 从句用过去完成时，主句用 would have + 过去分词；别和第2类混为一谈。

exercises.q: 根据课文填空：The tunnel would be well ________ if tall ________ were built above ________ ________.
用 serve as 改写：The platform would be used as a port and a railway station.
exercises.a: The platform would serve as a port and a railway station.

exercises.q: 根据课文填空：In 1860, a better plan was ________ ________ by an Englishman, William Low.
用 draw in 完成句子：If a train entered this tunnel, it ________ ________ fresh air behind it.
用 double 与 solve the problem of 合并两句：William Low suggested building a railway tunnel with two tracks. This would deal with the difficulty of ventilation.
exercises.a: William Low suggested that a double railway-tunnel should be built, and this would solve the problem of ventilation.
exercises.note: suggest 后从句用 should + 原形。

exercises.q: 汉译英：它于1994年3月7日正式开通，终于把英国与欧洲大陆连接了起来。
exercises.a: It was officially opened on March 7, 1994, finally connecting Britain to the European continent.

exercises.q: 句型分析：指出第3类条件句与第2类条件句在时态与含义上的差别。
exercises.a: 第3类：if 从句 had done，主句 would have done，与过去事实相反；第2类：if 从句过去时，主句 would + 动词原形，表现在或将来想象的情况。
exercises.note: 第3类谈过去，第2类谈现在或将来。

quiz.q: 1858年法国工程师提出的计划中，隧道的长度是？
quiz.note: 数词作前置定语时 mile 用单数。

quiz.q: 按照1858年的方案，建在海峡中央的平台将用作什么？
options: A hotel and a car park.
A port and a railway station.

quiz.q: 早期方案打算怎样让隧道保持良好的通风？
options: By fixing huge fans inside the tunnel.
By cutting windows in the tunnel walls.
By pumping air from both ends every hour.
By building tall chimneys above sea level.

quiz.q: 42年后真正开挖的隧道为什么没有建成？
options: Because the British feared invasion at the time.
Because there was not enough money.
Because the Channel was too deep to dig.
Because William Low gave up his plan.

quiz.q: 课文中 it would draw in fresh air behind it 的 draw in 是什么意思？
options: To take in or pull in (air).

quiz.q: 用第3类条件句完成课文原句：If, at the time, the British had not feared invasion, it ______.
